product.family: Parscan 48V spotlight, construction size M, narrow spot
product.description: a spotlight on the Minirail 48V system with a narrow spot Spherolit lens (the 5 degree class), 3000 K CRI 97, On-board Dim; its body under the Cube's soffit ring
product.codeBasis: the 3000 K CRI 97 narrow spot article's number was not found; its 3500 K CRI 92 sibling is A1014612

light.fluxBasis: not read for 3000 K CRI 97; the 3500 K CRI 92 sibling A1014612 gives 348 lm and 27 525 cd from a 4.3 W, 417 lm module

housing.materials: cast aluminium housing, polymer upper cover and lens unit, Spherolit lens of optical polymer

photometricFile.note: ERCO publishes a data sheet and an IES file per article; the 3000 K article's were not found.

sources.title: ERCO, data sheet A1014612 Parscan 48V Spotlight, size M, narrow spot, 3500 K CRI 92, edition 28.04.2026 (348 lm, Imax 27 525 cd, 6.0 W, 0.55 kg)
ERCO, Parscan 48V (product page): Spherolit lenses narrow spot, spot, flood, wide flood, oval flood, wallwash; 2700 to 4000 K, CRI up to 97 at 3000 K

unverified: The flux, peak intensity and beam angle of the 3000 K CRI 97 narrow spot article: its article number was not found, so the record stands unlit until its data sheet is read.
The Cube's sheet asks for a 5 degree beam with a 2 degree core; the sibling's data sheet draws its cone at 4.4 degrees.
